profile.headline: AI Software Engineer at Flex
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, React, microservices, and AWS. Experienced in backend development, cloud-native solutions, API integration, database optimization, and automation, with a growing focus on Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI-powered workflows.

Passionate about solving complex problems, improving system performance, and delivering reliable software solutions that drive business impact. Open to opportunities in Senior Software Engineering, Backend Development, AI/ML, and Generative AI.

positions.title: AI/ML Software Engineer
positions.description:
 Developed Java and Spring Boot microservices integrated with Python-based AI/ML services, supporting financial data processing, model inference, and secure API communication across enterprise applications. 
 Built REST APIs using Spring Boot and FastAPI to integrate machine learning models into backend workflows, improving prediction response times by 22% through optimized request handling. 
 Implemented Generative AI and LLM-powered workflows using LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector embeddings to support internal knowledge retrieval and financial document analysis. 
 Optimized PostgreSQL and Oracle SQL queries through indexing, execution-plan analysis, and data validation, reducing processing time by 18% for ML-related data retrieval and reporting. 
 Integrated AWS S3, Lambda, SQS, and SNS to support asynchronous data processing, model inference requests, and scalable communication between Java services and Python-based ML components. 
 Developed automated unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit, Mockito, Pytest, and Postman, validating backend services, ML inference endpoints, and application reliability during releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
 Developed Java and Spring Boot components for software supporting convenience retail operations, improving service maintainability through modular design and reusable business logic for retail clients. 
 Built REST APIs for pricing, product, and operational workflows, validating requests and responses to support integration between enterprise applications and customer-facing systems and partner services. 
 Optimized SQL queries and database access using Hibernate and JDBC, reducing response time by 20% across frequently used application functions and reporting workflows for applications. 
 Implemented scheduled processing and messaging with RabbitMQ, improving reliability of background jobs and reducing manual intervention for recurring data synchronization tasks across applications by 16%. 
 Created unit and integration tests with JUnit and Mockito, identifying defects before deployment and improving regression coverage across shared services and application modules during releases.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
 Created responsive travel protection interfaces using JavaScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3, improving form usability and reducing page interaction errors by 18% across customer journeys online. 
 Integrated frontend components with REST APIs to display travel plan details, claim information, and validation messages, improving consistency across customer-facing workflows and service screens reliably. 
 Implemented client-side validation and reusable interface components, reducing incomplete submissions by 16% and helping customers enter policy and trip information accurately across web application forms. 
 Investigated browser compatibility and layout defects using developer tools, resolving rendering issues across supported browsers and improving consistency on desktop and mobile screens across devices. 
 Collaborated with backend developers and QA analysts to verify API responses, reproduce defects, and validate fixes before releases of customer-facing travel services and workflows consistently.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: • Collaborated with stakeholders by sharing Postman collections and documentation, facilitating clear communication and understanding of API functionalities. • Established a robust component library using Angular Material, reducing development time by 20% through code reusability and standardized UI elements. • Integrated an AWS SQS queue with a microservice architecture to handle asynchronous tasks and improve responsiveness in a social media application. • Collaborated with front-end developers to optimize API responses, improving overall application performance. • Employed Django and Flask to build RESTful APIs for user authentication, content creation, and news feed management. • Implemented search functionality using Elasticsearch with various searchable fields, including autocomplete, fuzzy search, and stemming, achieving a search accuracy rate and reducing search query latency. • Integrated Django with PostgreSQL and implemented best data validation and migration practices, ensuring data integrity and security.

projects.title: Frequent Itemset mining using Ant-colony-optimization
projects.description: “Frequent Item set Mining Using Ant Colony Optimization" (ACO) is an integrated approach to identifying, acquiring, and retaining DATA. By enabling organizations to manage and co-ordinate customer interactions across multiple Product, lines of business, ACO helps organizations minimize the path of searching item for every customer interaction with product search for superior corporate performance using .NET Technology.

projects.title: Download Manager
projects.description: A download manager is a software tool that manages the downloading of files from the Internet, which may be built: into a Web browser, or as a, usually more sophisticated, stand-alone manager.
